# Weeber

> AI voice agents that answer and make customer calls — booking appointments, recovering abandoned carts, and following up on orders. Human-sounding, 24/7, no code required.

## What is Weeber?

Weeber is a no-code voice AI platform for small and medium businesses. It handles inbound and outbound phone calls using natural-sounding AI agents powered by ElevenLabs. Businesses use Weeber to recover abandoned carts, confirm COD orders, book appointments, and follow up with customers — without hiring a call center.

## Who is it for?

- Shopify merchants who lose revenue to abandoned carts and unconfirmed COD orders
- Healthcare clinics that miss appointment calls after hours
- Local service businesses that can't afford a receptionist for every call

## Key Features

- Natural voice conversations (callers often don't realize it's AI)
- Shopify, WhatsApp, and Google Calendar integrations
- TCPA and consent compliance built-in
- Full call transcripts and analytics dashboard
- No code required — configure agents with simple rules
